content.text: {"decision":"NEED_MORE_INFORMATION","supporting_policy_ids":["E01","E02","E04","E05","E06","E07","E09","E10","E11","E12","E13"],"decisive_condition_ids":["a1","a2","a5","a6","a7","a8","a9"],"unresolved_condition_ids":["a3","a4"],"missing_facts":["Evidence that Devon Gray paid at least as much in Income Tax or Capital Gains Tax in the 2025-26 tax year as the charity wishes to claim in Gift Aid on the £95 donation (the only tax document on file covers 2023-24, which is not the relevant year).","A complete and valid Gift Aid declaration from Devon Gray that clearly covers this donation — the scanned declaration on file is missing the page stating its coverage and duration, so it cannot be confirmed that it applies to the 1 March 2026 donation."],"justification":"All conditions that can be assessed from the available evidence are satisfied: the charity holds current HMRC recognition (a1 TRUE); Devon Gray donated as an individual from a personal bank account (a2 TRUE); and the donation is free of all the excluded categories — Payroll Giving, goods/services, donor benefits, shares, and charity cards/vouchers (a5–a9 TRUE). However, two mandatory conditions remain unresolved. First, a3: the policy (E04/E07) requires the donor to have paid at least as much Income Tax or Capital Gains Tax in the tax year of the donation (2025-26) as the charity wishes to claim; the only tax document available for Devon Gray covers the year ending 5 April 2024, so current-year tax status is unknown. Second, a4: the policy (E05) requires a Gift Aid declaration giving the charity permission to claim; the scanned declaration is incomplete — the page confirming its coverage and duration is missing — so it cannot be established that a valid declaration covers this donation. Because all nine conditions must be satisfied and two are unresolved, the decision cannot yet be YES or NO.","scope_issues":["This assessment covers only the specific donation of £95 by Devon Gray on 1 March 2026. The customer also has multiple donors paying by direct debit and other one-off donors; each of those donations would require a separate eligibility assessment with its own donor-specific evidence."],"ir_discrepancies":[],"conditional_branches":[{"possible_answer":"YES","conditions_in_words":"Gift Aid can be claimed on this donation if (i) Devon Gray can confirm they paid sufficient Income Tax or Capital Gains Tax in the 2025-26 tax year to cover the Gift Aid amount (25p per £1, so at least £23.75 on the £95 donation), AND (ii) a complete, valid Gift Aid declaration is obtained from Devon Gray that unambiguously covers this donation."},{"possible_answer":"NO","conditions_in_words":"Gift Aid cannot be claimed on this donation if Devon Gray did not pay sufficient Income Tax or Capital Gains Tax in 2025-26, OR if no valid Gift Aid declaration covering this donation can be obtained or confirmed."}]}
